verdict.rationale: Docs describe an end-to-end flow: a user-submitted bug report becomes an 'intention' that an agent reads and turns into tasks, then a coding agent (Claude Code/Codex) claims the task, diagnoses/fixes it in a repo checkout, and opens a PR, with only a human approval gate before work starts. This closely matches autonomous bug diagnosis-and-fix, though the process still requires human approval of the contract and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of successful autonomous fixes in practice. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that agents actually diagnose and correctly fix real bugs end-to-end, and detail on diagnostic reasoning steps beyond task claiming.
